detail.longDescription:
Take your DeepSeek Harness sessions with you. DSH Mobile lets you continue conversations, follow task progress and approve what the AI agent wants to do, all from your iPhone, while the work keeps running on your own computer.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Continue the conversation – pick up any session from your computer and watch replies stream in live.
• Approve or deny tool actions – when the agent wants to run a command or change files, you decide with one tap.
• Answer the agent's questions – respond when it needs your input, so tasks never sit waiting.
• Follow tasks at a glance – recent sessions and their running state, with active and archived sessions kept apart.
• Get notified – alerts when a task finishes, the agent asks something or a run fails, plus a notification center to catch up.
• Browse workspace files and send images – look through files in the workspace and send photos or screenshots to a session.
• Scan to connect – scan the QR code on your computer, or type the address and access token yourself.
• Try the demo first – a built-in demo with sample data needs no computer and no account.

HOW IT WORKS
DSH Mobile is a companion, not a standalone AI. It connects to DeepSeek Harness running on your own computer over your local Wi-Fi, so your sessions, files and credentials travel between your phone and your computer, not through our servers.
1. Download, install and sign in to DeepSeek Harness on your computer.
2. Open the third-party plugins page and add a plugin: More → Browse more plugins → Add plugin.
3. Enter the plugin address: @dsh-mobile/mobile-remote
4. Fully restart DeepSeek Harness.
5. Click your user name at the bottom left to open Settings.
6. Open the “Connect mobile device” page and scan the QR code with the app. Your phone and computer must be on the same Wi-Fi.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics or tracking SDKs.
• The access token is kept in the iOS Keychain.
• Sessions, files and images go only between your phone and your computer.

REQUIREMENTS
DeepSeek Harness for desktop with the DSH Mobile plugin, on a computer you control, and an iPhone on the same Wi-Fi. The app follows your device language: English or Simplified Chinese.

Help: support@claud.ing · https://dsh.claud.ing/en/support/
DSH Mobile is an independent mobile companion for DeepSeek Harness. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
